info.name: Order & Payment API Documentation
info.description: REST API for managing orders and payments, with pluggable payment gateways, secured with JWT.

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Register, log in and manage your JWT. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on every other endpoint.
Login and register are limited to 5 requests per minute per IP.

item.name: Orders
item.description:
Create and manage your orders. You only ever see and change your own orders.

Status flow: `pending` → `confirmed` or `cancelled`; `confirmed` → `cancelled` (only while unpaid).
Customer details and items can only change while the order is `pending`.

item.name: Payments
item.description:
Pay for confirmed orders and view payments. Gateways are simulated:

- `credit_card`: a card number ending in `0002` is declined; any other card is approved.
- `paypal`: an email ending in `@decline.test` is declined; any other email is approved.

Every payment request needs an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key returns the
original payment (200) and never charges twice.

query.description: Items per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 15.

request.description: All payment attempts for one of your orders, including failed ones.

response.body: {"status": 403, "message": "You don't have permission to access this resource"}
response.name: Someone else's order

request.description:
Charges a `confirmed` order through the chosen gateway for the order's full total.
A declined payment is still saved (status `failed`, HTTP 201), and the order can be paid again with a new key.

The fields inside `details` depend on `payment_method`:
- `credit_card`: `card_number`, `expiry_month`, `expiry_year`, `cvv`, `holder_name`
- `paypal`: `paypal_email`
